summary: Tested new stage: auto-generate daily absensi + client-side filters/search + cron webhook auth. Backend: 7/7 pytest passed for /api/generate-absensi (idempotent, non-destructive, defaults to today Asia/Jakarta) and /api/cron/generate-absensi (401 no-auth, 401 wrong token, 200 valid bearer). Frontend: home loads 5 students, Generate button triggers POST /api/generate-absensi and toast 'Generate selesai: X baris dibuat, Y sudah ada' appears; S002 manual edit (Sakit) preserved after generate; class filter, status filter, name search (case-insensitive substring), and combined filters all work; no-match-message shows correctly on empty result. Note: initial 'Belum' badge state could not be observed because prior backend tests had already generated rows for today; the code path is verified via App.js line 329 (renders 'Belum' when Status is empty).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is still declared AFTER route definitions (line 178) although routes use logger.error. Works because handlers execute later, but ordering remains fragile — same comment from iter1.

sheets_service.generate_absensi_for_date holds _SHEETS_LOCK for both reads and the append; that is correct for idempotency but means concurrent /api/siswa or /api/absensi calls will serialize behind a running generate (~1-2s). Acceptable for this app size.

.emergent/crons.yml not verified in tests (out of scope for backend HTTP test); manual verification recommended that BASE_URL is a public URL reachable from the cron runner and that WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET matches.
test_credentials: N/A (no user auth). Cron Bearer secret read from backend/.env WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests populated today's Absensi rows via generate (5 Hadir), then manually set S002 -> Sakit (keterangan 'flu'). Non-destructive: subsequent generates left S002 unchanged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sheet state after this run: 5 rows for today's date. S001/S003/S004/S005=Hadir, S002=Sakit ('flu'). If you need the initial 'Belum' scenario again, headers-only reset of Absensi sheet is required outside the API. Frontend selectors are stable; use page.select_option for native <select> filters (filter-kelas, filter-status, status-select-<ID>).
rca of the issue: No new issues; iteration_1 RCA (Sheets Http thread-safety fixed via _SHEETS_LOCK) still valid and in place in sheets_service.py.
